Rule 67:10:07:10 Vendor payment for rent -- Voluntary. CHAPTER 67:10:07

          67:10:07:10.  Vendor payment for rent -- Voluntary. A caretaker relative may request the department to make a vendor payment for the assistance unit's rent. The caretaker relative must make the request in writing. The department shall make the vendor warrant payable to the assistance unit's landlord.

          This vendor payment continues until the assistance unit is no longer eligible for assistance or the caretaker relative sends a written notice to the department requesting that the payment be discontinued.

          Source: 24 SDR 24, effective August 31, 1997.

          General Authority: SDCL 28-7A-3(7).

          Law Implemented: SDCL 28-7A-3(7).
